decision_summary: Proceed with QIF v0.6.7 Tool Guardrail Policy.
rationale: Current agent guidance emphasizes guardrails around inputs, outputs, and tool calls. QIF needs provider-neutral guardrail policy and evidence so approval does not substitute for executable checks.
recommendation: Release v0.6.7 after npm test and repository hygiene checks pass.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI agents using Action Quality Contract
expected_user_reaction: They can see which guardrails ran before and after a tool action and whether they tripped.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add toolGuardrailPolicies and guardrailEvidence to action-quality-contract schema, example, verifier, fixtures, docs, and release notes.
organization_change_recommendations: Keep verifier boundary explicit: guardrail records do not prove guardrail sufficiency or undo external side effects.
